# Understanding Anxiety

## Common symptoms
Anxiety can cause a racing heart, tight chest, restlessness, sweating and difficulty concentrating. Many people also notice constant worry and trouble relaxing.

## Grounding technique: 5-4-3-2-1
Name five things you can see, four you can touch, three you can hear, two you can smell and one you can taste. This pulls attention back to the present moment and can calm a spike of anxiety.

## Slow breathing
Breathe in through the nose for four seconds, hold for two, and breathe out slowly for six seconds. Repeat for a few minutes. Longer out-breaths help the body settle.

## Talking therapies
Cognitive behavioural therapy, or CBT, helps people notice unhelpful thought patterns and test them against reality. It is usually delivered over a limited number of sessions with a trained therapist.
